newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil gov't says won't help defaulting states.
newsitem.headline: Brazil gov't says won't help defaulting states.

text.p: The Brazilian government will not bail out states defaulting on maturing bonds, Presidential spokesman Sergio Amaral said.
Amaral told reporters Alagoas state, which Monday failed to pay off 109.3 million reais in bonds, was on its own.
"The government will not pay off the bonds of Alagoas," he said.
Amaral added that states in similar situations "should not expect the government to bail them out with taxpayers money".
Alagoas defaulted on the loans after failing to get authorization to roll over the debt.
Officials suspect the money raised through the securities, which by law should have been used to pay off court-ordered debts, was instead spent on other things.
